pages.text: $(bold)The Harbinger$() and $(bold)Ignis$() hold $(bold)Arcane industry$(): enchantment as a factory, dragon's breath as a fluid.$(br)$(bold)Ender Guardian$() (the End) holds $(bold)Ender logistics$(): ender chests, portable interfaces, item vaults. $(bold)Scylla$() (warm ocean) shares it.
$(bold)Hovering Inferno$() holds loot, not knowledge: the best artifacts in the Nether.$(br2)Two Blueprints at the end of the world, and both of them about moving things.
